narr: A slow moving Low brought several rounds of thunderstorms to the Eastern Washington. The thunderstorms produced large hail, strong winds, and flash flooding to the region. The first round impacted Southeast WA. The Low increased instability and low level moisture leading to decent afternoon convection.
ev: Mud and debris over highway 12 from heavy rain from a thunderstorm. One lane closed and police had to help direct traffic.
